identificationModule.briefTitle: Sodium Thiosulfate in Preventing Hearing Loss in Young Patients Receiving Cisplatin for Newly Diagnosed Germ Cell Tumor, Hepatoblastoma, Medulloblastoma, Neuroblastoma, Osteosarcoma, or Other Malignancy
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized Phase III Study of Sodium Thiosulfate for the Prevention of Cisplatin-Induced Ototoxicity in Children

armGroups.label: STS Arm (sodium thiosulfate treatment)
armGroups.description: Patients receive sodium thiosulfate IV (dosage 16 g/m2 or 533 mg per kg for patients whose therapeutic protocol administers cisplatin on a per kg basis due to young age or small body) over 15 minutes beginning 6 hours after the completion of each cisplatin infusion. Treatment with sodium thiosulfate continues until the completion of cisplatin therapy.

armGroups.label: Observation Arm (No sodium thiosulfate treatment)
armGroups.description: Patients do not receive sodium thiosulfate.
